commander_identity.mechanical_plan: Cecily, Haunted Mage ({1}{U}{B}{R}, 3/5 Human Wizard) draws on attack and, with eleven or more cards in hand, free-casts an instant or sorcery from hand. Bjorna, Nightfall Alchemist ({U}{R}, 1/3) sacrifices artifacts to ping and goad, keeping attackers off us. Lutri, the Spellchaser is the companion (project exception) and copies one big spell. The deck draws to eleven-plus with Rhystic Study, The One Ring, Trade Secrets and Yawgmoth's Bargain, then attacks to free-cast Apex of Power, Mnemonic Deluge, In Garruk's Wake, Peer into the Abyss or Teferi's Ageless Insight.
commander_identity.natural_ceiling: Power Bracket 4 (Optimized). Ten Game Changers (Cyclonic Rift, Demonic Tutor, Fierce Guardianship, Jeska's Will, Mystical Tutor, Notion Thief, Rhystic Study, The One Ring, Underworld Breach, Vampiric Tutor), all unchanged; none of the adds is a Game Changer. Combos: Breach + Wheel of Fortune + Jeska's Will (finite loop needing a payoff), Crawler + Peer, Peer + Teferi (self-deck risk), and the new Toad + Peer win. Not cEDH.
commander_identity.anti_homogenization: Every add serves Cecily's attack trigger or protects the turn it happens: two trigger copiers, a win condition for the big hand, a hand-size draw MDFC, and two protection/stack cards. Generic staples (Arcane Denial, Swan Song, Reliquary Tower) were rejected on deck-specific grounds.

whole_deck_audit.roles_and_overlaps: All 98 library cards plus the companion reviewed by quantity (97 rows; Island x2). Roles: 33 lands, 9 rocks (Sol Ring, Arcane Signet, three Signets, three Talismans, Thought Vessel), draw engines (Rhystic Study, The One Ring, Trade Secrets, Yawgmoth's Bargain, wheels), tutors, free-cast payoffs, Bjorna artifact fodder, and protection. Overlaps: two red rituals (Seething Song, Mana Geyser) and several low-impact artifact creatures (Emry, Engineer, Sai).
whole_deck_audit.mana_base_and_curve: Baseline: 33 lands + 9 rocks; average nonland MV 3.338; pips U 36, B 21, R 29. Candidate: 33 lands + Sea Gate MDFC + 9 rocks; average nonland MV 3.369; pips U 41, B 20, R 26. P(2-5 lands in opening 7) 0.747 -> 0.764; P(4+ mana sources in top 11) 0.782 -> 0.802 (hypergeometric, 98 cards). Two rituals removed.
whole_deck_audit.interaction_resilience: Stack: Counterspell, Fierce Guardianship, plus Mana Drain and Deflecting Swat. Removal: Cyclonic Rift, Toxic Deluge, In Garruk's Wake, Bjorna pings. Wins without Cecily: Twenty-Toed Toad, Psychosis Crawler, Breach loops. Weak points: graveyard hate turns off Breach, artifact hate turns off Bjorna and Resonator.

whole_deck_audit.current_baseline_strength: A strong Bracket 4 Cecily spellslinger with ten Game Changers. Pass C kept it unchanged but flagged a real question: whether a cheap Cecily trigger copier (Strionic Resonator) is worth a slot. The deck also lacked a win condition that turns a full hand into a win without needing the combo pieces.

material_candidates.source: EDHREC pair page 6/120 (Utility Artifacts); the exact M6 Pass C test-only challenger; live Scryfall batch
material_candidates.role: Two-mana artifact: {2},{T} copies any triggered ability we control.
material_candidates.incumbent_opportunity_cost: Loses Emry's random mill-4 and the once-per-turn recast of an artifact from the graveyard (affinity discount). Emry's value depends on milling the right artifacts.
material_candidates.commander_synergy: A copied Cecily attack trigger is a second draw plus a second hand-size check and free cast, so one attack can cast two expensive spells (707.10). It also copies Lutri's ETB (a third copy of the spell), Archmage Emeritus, Storm-Kiln Artist and Mana Drain's delayed mana. It is an artifact, so Bjorna can sacrifice it later.
material_candidates.adversarial_downside: Needs {2} open in combat and is an artifact-removal target. Harmonic Prodigy overlaps when it is on the battlefield.
material_candidates.reason: Pass C asked exactly this question but cut In Garruk's Wake. Cutting Emry instead keeps the one-sided wipe that Pass C defended and still gives Cecily a cheap trigger doubler.

material_candidates.source: OFF-RANKING (absent from the pair page); live Scryfall batch
material_candidates.role: Three-mana 1/4 vigilance creature: {1},{T} copies a triggered or activated ability from a creature source.
material_candidates.incumbent_opportunity_cost: Loses Engineer's artifact tutor-to-graveyard and its reanimation of cheap artifacts. The deck has few strong MV<=3 artifact targets, so that line is weak.
material_candidates.commander_synergy: Vigilance lets Echo attack next to Cecily and still tap to copy her trigger for {1}. It also copies Archmage Emeritus, Storm-Kiln, Psychosis Crawler and Niv-Mizzet triggers, and Bjorna's activated ability (ping and goad twice for one artifact).
material_candidates.adversarial_downside: Legendary creature, must be free of summoning sickness, and dies to any creature removal.
material_candidates.reason: A second cheap trigger copier. With Resonator and Harmonic Prodigy, Cecily's ten-card-hand attack converts to two or more free casts more often, without needing a second combat.

material_candidates.source: OFF-RANKING (absent from the pair page); Commander Spellbook 1561-5850; live Scryfall batch
material_candidates.role: Four-mana 3/3 Frog Wizard: maximum hand size twenty; draws when we attack with two or more creatures; wins on attack with twenty cards in hand.
material_candidates.incumbent_opportunity_cost: Loses Sai's Thopter-per-artifact-spell and its sac-two-draw-one. That is low impact in a 17-artifact deck that rarely chains artifact spells.
material_candidates.commander_synergy: Cecily's plan is to hold a large hand. Toad turns that into a win: Peer into the Abyss on ourselves, Yawgmoth's Bargain, Trade Secrets or Sea Gate Restoration reaches twenty cards. Attacking alongside Cecily also draws a card. It is a Wizard, so Harmonic Prodigy doubles its triggers.
material_candidates.adversarial_downside: It must survive a turn and attack. The win is visible and invites removal, and it does nothing on the turn it is cast.
material_candidates.reason: It gives the deck a win condition that does not need Cecily to survive and converts the existing draw spells into a deterministic attack-trigger win (Spellbook 1561-5850).

material_candidates.card: Sea Gate Restoration // Sea Gate, Reborn
material_candidates.source: EDHREC pair page 15/120 (Lands); live Scryfall batch
material_candidates.role: Modal double-faced card: seven-mana draw-hand-plus-one with no maximum hand size, or an untapped Island-like land for 3 life.
material_candidates.incumbent_opportunity_cost: Loses Dark Deal's symmetrical discard-hand-then-draw-minus-one. Dark Deal shrinks our hand below Cecily's eleven, so its loss costs little.
material_candidates.commander_synergy: Free-cast by Cecily with ten or more cards in hand, it draws eleven or more and removes the hand-size limit. That also sets up Twenty-Toed Toad. Early on it is a land, so it cuts mana screw.
material_candidates.adversarial_downside: Seven mana by hand. As a land it costs 3 life to enter untapped.
material_candidates.reason: A land in bad hands and a big Cecily free-cast payoff in good ones. It replaces a symmetrical card that works against our own plan.

material_candidates.source: EDHREC pair page 24/120 (Instants); live Scryfall batch
material_candidates.role: Free (with a commander out) redirect of a spell or ability's targets.
material_candidates.incumbent_opportunity_cost: Loses Mana Geyser's big red burst (one R per tapped opponent land), a ritual that needs opponents to have tapped out.
material_candidates.commander_synergy: Bjorna costs two and is usually on the battlefield, so Swat is free. It protects Cecily or a combo piece from targeted removal while the deck taps out for big spells.
material_candidates.adversarial_downside: Does nothing against wraths or counterspells that do not target, and it needs a commander on the battlefield to be free.
material_candidates.reason: The deck had only two counterspells and Fierce Guardianship as free protection. Swat protects the attack turn at no mana cost.

material_candidates.source: EDHREC pair page 21/120 (Instants); live Scryfall batch (not a Game Changer)
material_candidates.role: Two-mana counterspell that adds colorless mana equal to the countered spell's MV in our next main phase.
material_candidates.incumbent_opportunity_cost: Loses Seething Song's instant-speed burst of five red mana, used to chain into Apex of Power or Mnemonic Deluge.

low_swap_heightened_audit.strongest_argument_against_baseline: Cecily rewards an eleven-card hand, yet the baseline had no way to turn a huge hand into a win without combo pieces, only one trigger doubler (Harmonic Prodigy), thin stack protection, and several artifact creatures that do not interact with Cecily at all.
low_swap_heightened_audit.evidence_based_answer: Swap three low-impact artifact creatures and three symmetrical or ritual spells for two Cecily trigger copiers, a hand-size win condition, an MDFC draw spell, and two protection spells. Lands stay at 33 plus one MDFC.

final_candidate.deckwide_reconciliation: Commanders first, then the documented companion line (1x Lutri, the Spellchaser [Companion], outside the 100), then 1x lines alphabetically (Island x2). Six substitutions against the canonical source. 33 lands + Sea Gate MDFC, 9 rocks; 100 physical cards verified by quantity (98 library + 2 commanders).

owner_authority.owner_approval_question: This deck is complete. Do you approve it?

open_ended_optimization_audit.remaining_99_review: After the six swaps, every remaining incumbent was re-read against the candidate pool. Seven post-floor challenges were recorded: two retained alternatives staged as seven-swap lists (Enter the Infinite, Peter Parker's Camera) and five rejected on deck-specific grounds.

post_floor_challenges.tradeoff: Enter the Infinite draws the library on a Cecily free cast and wins with Toad or Crawler, but it is uncastable by hand; Wheel of Misfortune is castable for four mana.
Camera is a third trigger copier and Bjorna fodder, but Greaves gives Cecily haste and protection on the turn she is cast.
Tower keeps a big hand, but it is colorless like Bog and redundant with Thought Vessel and Sea Gate Restoration; Bog answers opposing graveyard decks.
Gogo copies Cecily's trigger and is a Wizard, but Resonator and Echo already do this more cheaply and Manufactor feeds Bjorna artifacts.
Spellbook is a one-mana no-maximum-hand-size artifact, but Wellspring draws a card on entering and again when Bjorna sacrifices it.
Suspicion steals opponents' spells on a free cast, but Wake is the deck's only one-sided wipe and was defended by Pass C.
Leng removes the hand-size limit for one mana, but Thought Vessel also taps for mana toward four-mana Cecily.

adds: Sea Gate Restoration // Sea Gate, Reborn
larger_swap_packages.case_for_extra_swaps: Enter the Infinite on a Cecily free cast draws the whole library, which wins immediately with Twenty-Toed Toad attacking or Psychosis Crawler on the battlefield.
larger_swap_packages.why_not_selected: It is uncastable by hand (12 MV), and Peer into the Abyss plus Toad already cover the same job in the six-swap list.

adds: Sea Gate Restoration // Sea Gate, Reborn
larger_swap_packages.case_for_extra_swaps: A third trigger copier makes ten-card Cecily attacks into three free casts, and the Camera is an artifact Bjorna can sacrifice.
larger_swap_packages.why_not_selected: Three copiers is overkill, and losing Greaves removes haste and protection for Cecily on the turn she is cast.

open_ended_optimization_audit.quality_based_stop_reason: Stopped at six. The remaining weak-looking slots (Wheel of Misfortune, Lightning Greaves, Bojuka Bog, Academy Manufactor, Ichor Wellspring, In Garruk's Wake, Thought Vessel) each lose to their best challenger on deck-specific grounds: castability by hand, haste for Cecily, colored mana, Bjorna fodder value, or the unique one-sided wipe.
